summary: BACKEND-DEV (WF-02 Step 4 UNBLOCK) fixed the branch-introduced event-store test regression that failed Step 4 (TEST-RUNNER FAIL). (1) Dropped the ReadOpts.tenant_id initializers that SPT-03 commit 27ec5d6c orphaned: event_store_integration_test.zig:1543 and :1655 (.tenant_id = bpm.store.DEFAULT_TENANT_ID) as directed, PLUS :1679 (alt_events ReadOpts .tenant_id = alt_tenant) which the TEST-RUNNER report did not flag but which is the same removed-field compile break and would have kept the file non-compiling; comment updated to search_path-based tenant resolution. (2) Fixed the same class of break in adp06_pipeline_run_correlation_test.zig:217 (GlobalReadOpts) and :318 (HistoryReadOpts) so the branch ships no broken test file. (3) While running the suite, discovered and fixed a SECOND branch-introduced runtime regression from the same SPT-03 commit: removing tenant_id from the events_ephemeral INSERT column list was fine for events (migration 027 gave events.tenant_id a DEFAULT) but events_ephemeral.tenant_id is NOT NULL with NO default (migration 1149), so every delete-class append routed to events_ephemeral inserted tenant_id NULL (sqlstate 23502) and TC-ADP-11-02 failed at runtime — latent because the file never compiled on the branch. Fix: new migration 1163_events_ephemeral_tenant_id_default.sql gives events_ephemeral.tenant_id the same DEFAULT as events (parent + every existing partition via pg_inherits, %I-interpolated), design-consistent with §8.2 R3 (storage boundary carries no tenant_id; the column default is the deterministic fallback). Verification: zig build test-integration-event-store 29/29 PASS exit 0 (Build Summary 6/6 steps succeeded); zig build test-integration-spt 16/16 PASS exit 0; zig build exit 0 (4/4 steps succeeded, no error-set output); lint_migration_schema 0 violations (151 files); lint_sql_table_refs OK. lint_handoffs exit code reported separately in the handoff result.

issues_found.description: TEST-RUNNER's BLOCKER (ReadOpts.tenant_id compile error) was only the visible symptom. Running the suite exposed a SECOND branch-introduced regression from the same SPT-03 commit: removing tenant_id from the events_ephemeral INSERT column list while events_ephemeral.tenant_id remained NOT NULL with NO column default (migration 1149; events got its default from migration 027) made every delete-class append insert NULL (sqlstate 23502), breaking TC-ADP-11-02 at runtime. Latent because the file never compiled on the branch. Fixed by migration 1163 (same default as events on parent + all existing partitions).

adp06_pipeline_run_correlation_test.zig is NOT wired into build.zig (TEST-RUNNER noted this) — it never was a gate. Its removed-field break is now fixed (no broken test file ships on the branch), but it still does not run in CI; wiring it is a candidate for the follow-up SPT batch (now that it compiles).

The 'failed command:' text under `zig build test-integration-*` when the run emits stderr (e.g. TC-PAR01-04-01's intentional 23514 log) is the known cached-run / PowerShell native-stderr artifact (same observation as step-03 unblock) — the run step and overall build both exit 0; the authoritative result is the direct-binary run and the --summary all 'Build Summary: N/N steps succeeded'.
